ru.name: Быстрый выстрел: Смещение

tooltip: Урон удара: урон удара навыка Быстрый выстрел x 2

en.name: Stub Arrow: Evasive Shot

en.command: {KeyBind:MoveLeft} + {KeyBind:Attack2} or {KeyBind:MoveRight} + {KeyBind:Attack2} {KeyBind:MoveLeft} + {KeyBind:Attack2} or {KeyBind:MoveRight} + {KeyBind:Attack2} or {KeyBind:MoveBack} + {KeyBind:Dash} during Charged Stub Arrow while holding stub arrows
tooltip: Attack damage applies Stub Arrow's attack damage x2
Applies Stub Arrow's number of hit targets
Invincible -> Super Armor during the skill
